🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚨

📍 Moosapet – Parvathnagar Traffic Diversion
 From 16.05.2026 onwards for 30 Days

Due to CC Road development works from Jaya Shankar Statue to RRR Restaurant, traffic diversions are in place for smooth traffic flow.

🔀 Traffic from Toddy Compound towards Parvathnagar will be diverted at Parvathnagar Junction towards Sunnam Cheruvu / 100 Feet Road.

⚠️ Plan your travel in advance, use alternate routes, and follow diversion signboards.

- Cyberabad Traffic Police
